subject: Vendor onboarding: gating checklist, insurance evidence, and PO routing
messages:
From: Alex Reyes <alex.reyes@nimbleworks.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: vendor-ops@nimbleworks.com, legal@nimbleworks.com
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: gating checklist, insurance evidence, and PO routing

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist. We pulled together the COI and the vendor risk questionnaire and attached them for your review. A couple quick notes from our side:

- We have a primary GL policy for $2M; certificate attached (NimbleWorks_COI_2027-05.pdf).
- We completed your workbook and flagged two items where we need clarification on subcontractor disclosure and acceptable data retention windows.
- Our legal team wants to confirm whether Redwood requires an endorsement naming Redwood Inference as additional insured for both general liability and cyber.

We’re flexible on PO timing but would prefer to avoid a conditional PO if possible — it complicates internal billing. If Redwood can accept a PO with the COI on file and a short remediation plan captured in the onboarding doc, that would speed things up.

Attached: NimbleWorks_COI_2027-05.pdf; NimbleWorks_VendorRisk_QA_202705.xlsx

Best,
Alex Reyes
Vendor Ops | NimbleWorks

From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: alex.reyes@nimbleworks.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-23T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: gating checklist, insurance evidence, and PO routing

Alex — thank you, received both attachments and skimmed the risk workbook. Quick read: COI looks standard but the endorsement section is blank. Before we escalate to legal, I want to clarify Redwood’s procurement gating here so we’re aligned. Two paths we commonly use:

1) Full activation: endorsement naming Redwood Inference as additional insured + COI showing required limits (GL $1M/$2M PL/GL and Cyber limits) -> procurement issues full PO;
2) Conditional PO: we queue a limited-value PO (up to 30 days of spend) while vendor provides a remediation plan for missing endorsement items and updates within 14 days.

Jonas, can you confirm if Procurement is able to issue a conditional PO for NimbleWorks given our current QBR threshold? If not, we’ll need legal to provide a short exceptions memo.

Alex — to speed this up, please:
- Re-send the COI with the endorsement page (if available) or confirm insurer contact so we can request the endorsement.
- Fill section 6 in your worksheet re: subcontractors and the data-retention window; that’s the main blocker for our security review.

I’ve flagged this as medium-priority; we generally aim to clear onboarding holds within 7 business days.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Manager, Vendor Programs
Redwood Inference

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-23T13:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: gating checklist, insurance evidence, and PO routing

Olga — confirmed. Procurement can issue a conditional PO for up to $12,500 (30-day run rate) while legal/security complete remediation, but only when the vendor:

- Provides a COI showing current coverage (we have that), and
- Submits a written remediation plan with target dates (we’ll accept a 14-day plan for the outstanding endorsement and subcontractor disclosure), and
- Signs a minimal DPA addendum for processing PII (if applicable).

If all three are in progress (COI on file, remediation plan submitted, DPA addendum routing), I’ll authorize a conditional PO and route it to Finance for issuance. If any of these are missing, Procurement will hold.

Marissa — can you start the PO stub if Alex confirms they’ll submit the remediation plan by EOD tomorrow? I’ll include the conditional-PO note in the PR.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Procurement Manager

From: Alex Reyes <alex.reyes@nimbleworks.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: vendor-ops@nimbleworks.com, legal@nimbleworks.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-24T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: gating checklist, insurance evidence, and PO routing

Thanks all — quick status update:

- Legal confirmed insurer contact: underwriting@acme-insure.com; they will issue an endorsement naming Redwood Inference as additional insured for GL within 3 business days.
- We uploaded an updated workbook with subcontractor roster and a 14-day remediation plan to the Drive link (see related link).
- Attached the same COI for record.

We accept the conditional PO terms and request the PO stub so we can bind finance on our side and kick off initial integration work. Please let us know the PO number once available.

Attachments: NimbleWorks_COI_2027-05.pdf; NimbleWorks_VendorRisk_QA_202705.xlsx

Kind regards,
Alex Reyes
Vendor Ops | NimbleWorks
